doc.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998

chapter: Marriage and freelancing in New York
title: Meeting and marrying Dorothy 'Shorty' and daughter Kristen
summary: Married 1956 after meeting Dorothy through arranger Hershey Kay; their daughter Kristen.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Now when did you get married?
So that was during that, or was that just about—
That was after you got out.

That was immediately after. I had left the band and I took a Broadway show. My wife was an assistant choreographer and we went to Boston and she liked Lebanese food so the arranger was Hershey Kay and Hershey says, “Do you care if I bring a chick?” I says no. So he brought Dorothy. Shorty I called her. She was the assistant choreographer. He brought her to the restaurant and she ate everything I ordered. I says that’s the girl for me.

No I was the luckiest man. She’s the most wonderful thing that ever happened to me. And our daughter Kristen is the most wonderful that ever happened to us. So I’m blessed all the way around, as a musician and as a person, I can’t complain.
